record.one_liner: Airtable: a database-style workspace of bases, tables and records with a REST API for external integrations.
record.auth_notes: Personal access tokens (api_key class) and OAuth access tokens are the two supported methods. Legacy API keys were retired in February 2024. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: Free plan includes Base Data endpoints (except Views); public API limit enforced on Free. critic: access self_serve_free confirmed from billing-plans page.
record.api_notes: Base data endpoints cover records, fields, tables, bases, comments, webhooks, views and enterprise endpoints.
record.blocker_notes: critic: OAuth integration guide shows self-registration with a redirect URL; no vendor review step found for use. Privacy/TOS URLs only required to share an integration.

evidence.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.
Access to all "Base Data" endpoints except "Views"
The API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON to encode objects, and relies on standard HTTP codes to signal operation outcomes.
Airtable maintains its own official MCP server and skills library, built and supported directly by Airtable.
